summary: Frontend-only testing for MME Private Limited 'We Are' dropdown feature. Verified navbar dropdown on desktop, all 5 subpages (About Company, Board of Directors, Our Team, Our Clients, Annual Report) render with expected data-testids and content. Verified pre-existing routes (/, /services, /services/cement, /projects, /industries, /clients, /gallery, /careers, /contact) load without compile-error overlay. Verified mobile (390px) hamburger, 'We Are' accordion expansion revealing all 5 subpages, and mobile About Company page layout. Annual report download button correctly shows an 'available soon' toast.

issues: Document title still reads 'Emergent | Fullstack App' — should be branded (e.g. 'MME Private Limited') for a production marketing site.

action_items: (Optional/low-priority) Update public/index.html <title> to a branded MME title for SEO and browser tab clarity.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar.jsx desktop dropdown: parent 'We Are' is a <Link to='/we-are'> but no such route exists — clicking the parent label (not a child) on desktop navigates to an undefined route. Consider making the parent a non-navigating element or route to a landing page.

Mobile drawer: same issue — the parent 'We Are' text is a Link, so tapping the label (instead of the '+') navigates to /we-are (currently no page). Consider disabling nav on parent or adding a /we-are route.
Page <title> is not set per-route; consider using react-helmet or document.title updates per page.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 'We Are' subpages render correctly with the documented data-testids. Mobile accordion expand is the second interactive control per nav row (a button containing only the Plus icon) — select it via 'div.fixed.inset-0 button.text-[#c8a25c]' (first match is 'We Are'). Desktop dropdown is hover-triggered. Base URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. No backend involvement.
